records.copyright_owner: His Majesty the King in Right of Canada
records.disposition_basis: A captured federal enactment permits reproduction by anyone without charge or permission and draws no commercial or non-commercial distinction. The two stated conditions are accuracy due diligence and not representing the reproduction as an official version; both are satisfiable by freezing unmodified bytes and labelling them as an unofficial copy.
records.internal_research_use_basis: Reproduction of Federal Law Order, SI/97-5, captured byte-exact, states: 'Anyone may, without charge or request for permission, reproduce enactments and consolidations of enactments of the Government of Canada, and decisions and reasons for decisions of federally-constituted courts and administrative tribunals, provided due diligence is exercised in ensuring the accuracy of the materials reproduced and the reproduction is not represented as an official version.' SOR/87-402 is a regulation made under the Financial Administration Act and is therefore an enactment of the Government of Canada; the Justice Laws Website consolidated XML is a consolidation of that enactment.
records.modification_restrictions: SI/97-5 conditions reproduction on due diligence in ensuring accuracy. Bytes are frozen verbatim with no normalization, re-encoding, or reformatting. Any derived rendering must not be presented as the regulation itself.
records.publisher: Department of Justice Canada (Justice Laws Website)
source_specific_limitations: The consolidation is published by the Minister of Justice; the original regulation or its registered amendments prevail over the consolidation in case of inconsistency.
SI/97-5 is a general federal reproduction order. No counsel review of its application to this repository has occurred.
